summary: @servicetitan/startup-mfe-compat 0.5.1 drops Bun runtime at preinstall to execute obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs". setup.mjs downloads a platform-specific Bun 1.3.13 runtime zip from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts it to a temporary directory, marks the binary executable, and invokes it against math_init.js in the package root. math_init.js is a 727KB Bun-compiled bundle (sha256 9fc2570b7cef51c1b8df116d144d11ff4096357be7d2c4c6367cfc2509cf1bcc) that uses string-array rotation obfuscation (an ~1000-entry mixed literal table and a rotator function). The obfuscated payload has no relation to the package's advertised micro-frontends compatibility CLI (dist/cli/*.js), and executing it via a separately-downloaded second-language runtime evades scanners that only trace Node-resolved code. The rest of the tarball (dist/) is a small legitimate-looking CLI, indicating either a publisher-account compromise or a scope-impersonation republish under the @servicetitan scope (homepage docs.st.dev, repo servicetitan/anvil-uikit-contrib).

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
